ctx:
婚禮上播的VLog節錄：\
\
☄️：會跟🌸關係好起來的契機就是武士道（爸爸），那時給了mcmt很多工商，然後是那場Live，雖然有這些工商機會非常高興，但一開始也不明白為什麼會是mcmt這個組合，因為那時跟🌸也不算熟。\
\
🌸：會想把Cover搶過來呢\
\
🌸：說到mcmt的話，彗醬就是唱歌，咪口的話就是咪口wwww\
☄️：🌸就是🌸，什麼都沒有啊wwww\
\
🌸：喜歡☄️會率直的跟營運方討論自己想法的這一點，即使被營運說「這件事可能有困難」，☄️會說「在這邊在那邊再努力一下不就能成了嗎」\
☄️：不在乎周遭的人的感覺嗎？\
🌸：沒這回事喔。那☄️尊敬菁櫻的地方呢？\
☄️：回去囉。\
🌸：老師！☄️不肯跟我說！\
☄️：應該是行動力吧，其實我是很害怕國外的呢，來了之後才發現也沒那麼可怕。\
🌸：下次想去哪裡呢？\
☄️：倫敦\
🌸：很不錯呢，也可以去巴黎看看，想去好多地方呢。\
☄️：想去\
\
🌸：很感恩☄️是我的工作對象\
☄️：我可是一個Yes Man呢\
🌸：？Yes Man ? 「這個我不想吃」什麼的⋯\
☄️：怎樣啦wwww\
🌸：不要用沙子弄我啦wwww\
🌸：但是對於（工作上的）提案的話☄️確實是呢 （☄️會對🌸說）「欸好像不錯呢」 「這個應該可以試試呢」\
\

ctx:
🌸在聊關於生活品質\
💬有人說🌸對寢具也很講究\
🌸就開始炫耀她2，3年前買的席夢思床，說席夢思床很好但很貴\
💬問是之前☄️學妳買的那個床嗎，兩人的床顏色是不是不同\
🌸看到立刻撿了\
說她跟☄️是同款式的床沒錯只是顏色不同\
☄️是黑的\
🌸是白的\
\
其實以前🌸☄️兩人在Error配信時就有提到這段\
就是因為🌸買了席夢思床之後\
一直對☄️炫耀席夢思床有多舒服\
所以☄️也去買了同款不同色的床\
（應是床頭板顏色不同）\
☄️在那個配信裡還笑稱那是商業床\
在配信當時很轟動\
當下還造成席夢思的網頁一度當機\
\
可是⋯我覺得她們買同樣床的原因是\
這樣的話\
🌸☄️兩人到任何一人家中睡覺都能很習慣吧～？！\
\
🌸 was talking about quality of life.\
💬 mentioned that 🌸 is very particular about her bedding.\
🌸 then started bragging about the Simmons bed she bought 2–3 years ago, saying it’s really great but very expensive.\
💬asked if it was the same bed ☄️ bought after being influenced by her, and whether their bed colors were different.\
🌸 immediately picked up on it, saying that she and ☄️ do indeed have the same model, but the colors are different.\
☄️’s is black\
🌸’s is white.\
\
Actually, back during the Error stream, 🌸 and ☄️ mentioned this before.\
After 🌸 bought her Simmons bed, she kept bragging to ☄️ about how comfortable it was.\
As a result, ☄️ also went and bought the same model but in a different color.\
(It seems the difference is in the headboard color.)\
☄️ even joked during the livestream that it was a “business bed”\
It caused quite a stir on the livestream\
Led to Simmons’ website crashing temporarily\
\
But… I think the real reason they bought the same bed is because, in this way,\
whenever 🌸 or ☄️ stay at each other’s homes, they can feel right at home, don’t you think~?!

💬問是之前☄️學妳買的那個床嗎，兩人的床顏色是不是不同\

說她跟☄️是同款式的床沒錯只是顏色不同\

🌸是白的\

☄️在那個配信裡還笑稱那是商業床\
在配信當時很轟動\
當下還造成席夢思的網頁一度當機\
\
可是⋯我覺得她們買同樣床的原因是\
這樣的話\

\

💬 mentioned that 🌸 is very particular about her bedding.\
🌸 then started bragging about the Simmons bed she bought 2–3 years ago, saying it’s really great but very expensive.\
💬asked if it was the same bed ☄️ bought after being influenced by her, and whether their bed colors were different.\
🌸 immediately picked up on it, saying that she and ☄️ do indeed have the same model, but the colors are different.\
☄️’s is black\
🌸’s is white.\
\
Actually, back during the Error stream, 🌸 and ☄️ mentioned this before.\
After 🌸 bought her Simmons bed, she kept bragging to ☄️ about how comfortable it was.\
As a result, ☄️ also went and bought the same model but in a different color.\
(It seems the difference is in the headboard color.)\
☄️ even joked during the livestream that it was a “business bed”\
It caused quite a stir on the livestream\
Led to Simmons’ website crashing temporarily\
\
But… I think the real reason they bought the same bed is because, in this way,\
whenever 🌸 or ☄️ stay at each other’s homes, they can feel right at home, don’t you think~?!

\\\\＼\
Tonight, the business coach Hoshimachi☄️,\
who appeared like a comet,\
will be coming to my house…\
And I’ll be getting direct training from her, Nye!😎!!!!\
Can I rise from a noob to a beginner――🔥
ctxJa:
🌸說到去年商業開工是由瑪利歐賽車開始的\
今年則是由👾舉辦的遊戲祭開始的\
然後🌸☄️兩人說了今年各自會出賽的遊戲項目\
\
這時☄️說：喔，那麼會跟妳在一起練習的。\
🌸：那就跟我在一起(付き合えばいいじゃん，指交往）嘛！\
☄️：www在一起www？⋯如果妳很希望這樣的話⋯我也是可以考慮看看的啦⋯如何呢⋯？\
\
🌸was speaking of last year’s business opening event, it started with Mario Kart.\
This year, it began with a gaming festival hosted by 👾.\
Then, 🌸 and ☄️ talked about the games they would participate in this year.\
\
At this point, ☄️ said: “Oh, then I’ll practice together with you.”\
🌸: “Then why not just be together with me (付き合えばいいじゃん, meaning ‘let’s date’)!”\
☄️: “www Be together with you, www? … If you really want that, I can consider it… What do you think…?”🌸在說自己聖誕節時的瑪莉歐派對玩的很爛，可是她忘了在她旁邊的就是一隻寂寞狗狗！\
☄️：（突然變哀怨的語氣）啊，是這樣啊，聖誕節，在我不在的時候，在我工作的時候，大家是那麼開心的在玩樂呢。\
🌸：彗醬，在年末時，妳很寂寞吧。\
☄️：真的啊⋯（🌸開始笑）大家都⋯幸好有聖誕節那個聚會。\
🌸：（可愛音）都要忘了妳的存在了喔。\
☄️：不要忘了我啊。\
\
🌸was talking about how badly she did at Mario Party during Christmas… but she forgot that right next to her was a lonely little puppy!\
☄️: (suddenly switching to a gloomy tone) Ah, I see. Christmas, huh? While I wasn’t there, while I was working, everyone was having so much fun together.\
🌸:Suichan, you must’ve felt really lonely at the end of the year.\
☄️: I really did… (🌸 laughs) Everyone… thankfully there was that Christmas gathering.\
🌸: (in a cute voice) It’s like we almost forgot about you!\
☄️: Don’t forget about me!配信中☄️發現自己的瑪利歐派對遊戲版本不對\
🌸馬上說可以請姊街幫忙在另一台Switch先下載正確版本\
再拿過來\
☄️立刻照著🌸指示轉達請姊街幫忙\
整個過程行雲流水一氣呵成\
姊街收到指示後的第一個反應居然是\
🌸待會要過來吃飯嗎\
這些都是她們平常相處最真實的樣貌\
我們在配信上有時得以窺見一二\
這樣的處理方式跟反應速度\
這不是家人是什麼\
\
During the stream, ☄️ realized that her Mario Party game version was incorrect.\
🌸 immediately suggested asking Anemachi for help to download the correct version on another Switch and then bring it over.\
☄️ promptly followed 🌸’s instructions and relayed the request to Anemachi.\
The entire process was smooth and seamless.\
\
Anemachi’s first response upon receiving the request was,\
“Is🌸coming over to eat later?”\
\
This interaction perfectly reflects the authenticity of their daily relationship, glimpses of which we occasionally catch during streams.\
Handling things this way and reacting like this—if this isn’t family, then what is?☄️：嘿咻，哎唷不錯喔，這什麼，啊出來了，出來了，出來好多（彈珠）就是這個，就是這個，就是這個⋯\
🌸：妳好吵啊www妳似乎玩得很開心嘛www\
☄️：真的好開心啊，我好開心啊，瑪利歐趴踢真的讓我好開心啊\
🌸：wwww\
☄️：嘿，嘿，嘿⋯\
🌸：妳的(彈珠)台Fever了？\
☄️：在Fever了，Fever Now!\
🌸：啊我的(Fever)也要來了!\
☄️：嘿咻，Hey, Hey, Hey,\
Yes, Yes, Yes, OH MY GOD!\
Come on pinball !\
🌸：喂先停止喊Yes比較好喔，一直喊Yes是⋯\
☄️：Oh! Oh! Yes! Yes!\
🌸：Oh! 快停止! Yes! 停止! Yes!\
☄️：Wow Hmmm Ohh Yeah OK!\
🌸：wwww\
☄️：wwww\
🌸：(看到出來的分數) 900分？！\
☄️：我玩的好開心！\
🌸：妳這樣是讓海外兄貴很開心啦\
\
☄️: Hey, hey, oh wow, not bad! What’s this? Oh, it’s coming out! So many came out (pinballs). This is it, this is it, this is it…\
🌸: You’re so loud, wwww. You seem to be having a lot of fun, wwww.\
☄️: I’m really happy. I’m so happy! Mario Party makes me so happy!\
🌸: wwww.\
☄️: Hey, hey, hey…\
🌸: Is your (pinball) table in Fever mode?\
☄️: It’s in Fever mode! Fever now!\
🌸: Ah, my (Fever) is about to come too!\
☄️: Hey, hey, hey, Yes, Yes, Yes, OH MY GOD! Come on, pinball!\
🌸: Hey, maybe you should stop shouting “Yes” so much. Constantly shouting “Yes” is like…\
☄️: Oh! Oh! Yes! Yes!\
🌸: Oh! Please stop! Yes! Stop! Yes!\
☄️: Wow, hmm, oh yeah, OK!\
🌸: wwww\
☄️: wwww\
🌸: (Seeing the score) 900 points?!\
☄️: I had so much fun!\
🌸: You’re definitely making the overseas bros really happy with this.\
2023年4月9日。\
🌸☄️史上第一次的線下連動！\
☄️那時也是為了要當🌸的教練而前往🌸家\
☄️的愛，從以前到現在，一直都沒變喔。\
\
☄️🌸今晚21時開始🌸☄️\
/／\
🔷《ぷよぷよテトリス2》大會特訓 🔷\
miComet 線下連動🏠\
\\\\＼\
今晚，那位如彗星般出現的\
商業教練星街☄️\
將來到我家……\
直接進行特訓啦捏😎！！！！！\
能否從雜魚變成初心者呢——🔥\
\
April 9th, 2023.\
The very first🌸☄️offline collab in history!\
Back then, ☄️went to 🌸’s house to be her coach.\
☄️’s affection, from then until now, has never changed.\
\
☄️🌸 Tonight at 21:00 🌸☄️\

👾因為Chained together自己也有參賽\
於是在下場前找了🌸☄️代打主持⋯\
理由是因為🌸和🚑之前也(痛苦地）\
配信多次玩了這個遊戲\
意思是說👾覺得要找🌸主持這段沒錯\

先把🌸☄️兩人Chained together\
\
Since👾was also participating in Chained Together, 👾decided to find🌸and☄️as substitutes to host before the match. The reasoning was that 🌸 and 🚑 had previously (and painfully) streamed this game multiple times together.\
\
In other words, 👾 thought it made sense to have 🌸 host this segment, but if they were going to involve 🌸, they absolutely had to bring in ☄️ too! So, before heading off to play Chained Together, 👾 first “chained together” 🌸 and ☄️.\
這算某種技能了吧\
在眾人都在講話很吵的狀況下\
🌸很小聲的說了一句彗醬我肚子餓了\
☄️馬上有反應\
說我也餓啦\
現在誰可以去預約一下燒肉\
🌸聽到馬上興奮大喊   燒肉！\
\
This could be considered a skill, right?\
In the middle of a noisy situation where everyone was talking, 🌸 quietly muttered, “Suichan, I’m hungry.”\
\
☄️ immediately responded, saying, “I’m hungry too! Who can make a reservation for Yakiniku right now?”\
\
As soon as 🌸 heard that, she excitedly shouted, “Yakiniku!”

ctx:
💬有人問這次的新專輯裡有沒有🌸能唱的歌\
☄️馬上撿了這個留言(毫不意外）\
☄️說🌸應該可以唱DEADPOOL\
然後☄️學著🌸的聲音開始清唱：\
\
🎵～アタシ何もしてないのですが\
気に障るよなコトしちゃった?\
何度目だか分からない\
また着火 また着火 焦げてる～🎵\
\
（我什麼都沒做呀\
是不是又做了什麼讓你不高興的事？\
都不知道是第幾次了\
又著火了又著火了，燒焦了）\
\
☄️唱完後似乎驚覺了什麼，然後說糟糕了，\
這首又要被🌸搶走了，\
而且之後一定會被🌸的迷因污染了，\
但☄️邊說邊笑，完全看不出覺得糟糕的樣子，\
而且邊笑邊學著🌸的聲音又唱了一次，\
只讓人看了覺得☄️學🌸唱歌很開心\
\
唱完後☄️突然認真說，\
🌸應該要做一首歌\
曲子本身要聽起來很有藝術感\
\
但歌詞是\
\
啊勒  我搞砸了呢\
我不小心打翻了岩漿\
家燒起來啦\
\
之類的\
\
因為之前麥塊裡的事件\
\
說完後\
☄️自己又開始笑了起來⋯\
\
💬asked if there are any songs in the new album that 🌸 could sing.\
☄️ Immediately picked up this comment (as expected)\
☄️ said that 🌸 might be able to sing “DEADPOOL” and then started singing it in 🌸’s voice:\
\
🎵 “I didn’t do anything at all,\
Did I do something to upset you?\
I’ve lost count of how many times this is,\
Again, it’s on fire, it’s on fire, it’s burning.” 🎵\
\
☄️ After singing, suddenly realized something and said, “Oh no, this song is going to get stolen by 🌸 again, and it’ll definitely be turned into one of 🌸’s memes later.” But while saying this, ☄️ was laughing the whole time, showing no signs of actually feeling bad.\
☄️ even sang it again in 🌸’s voice, looking completely happy to imitate 🌸 singing.\
\
After singing, ☄️ suddenly got serious and said that 🌸 should make a song where the melody feels very artistic, but the lyrics are like:\
\
“Oh no, I messed up,\
I accidentally spilled lava,\
Now the house is on fire.”\
\
Something like that,\
\
referencing past events in Minecraft.\
\
After saying that, ☄️ started laughing again…\
☄️如何慢慢融化🌸的心。\
\
☄️：\
「感謝大家來看我的《Super Mario Maker》配信！！🥳\
今天我玩了吹雪醬、咪口醬、詩音醬的關卡哦！！\
詩音醬的關卡我沒能通過！！實在是！！鬼畜！！！！👊💥\
下次我也想試著做一個自己的關卡！٩(๑❛ᴗ❛๑)۶」\
\
🌸🌽🌙三人皆無回應。\
⁦‪ 2019年7月2日。\
\
How☄️slowly melted🌸’s heart.\
\
☄️：\
“Thank you everyone for watching my 《Super Mario Maker》stream!! 🥳\
Today, I played courses made by Fubuki-chan, Miko-chan, and Shion-chan!!\
I couldn’t clear Shion-chan’s course!! It was just!! Too brutal!!!! 👊💥\
Next time, I want to try making my own course too! ٩(๑❛ᴗ❛๑)۶”\
\
No response from🌸🌽🌙.\
July 2nd, 2019.

ctx:
🌸說到\
☄️雖然也想跟大家一起玩Holonalds\
但因為工作太忙的關係\
所以整個一月應該都是沒辦法了\
🌸又說到🌸☄️和姊街\
一起去了手相的占卜🔮\
而且是在☄️難得的休息日\
🔮說了對🌸來說今年是準備和挑戰的一年\
而對🌸☄️兩人來說2026年將會是非常好的一年\
\
🌸繼續說著\
去年🌸☄️也和一大群人去過🔮\
那時的🔮也告訴🌸☄️兩人\
2026年將會是一個對🌸☄️來說非常重要的一年\
兩個不同的🔮都說了一樣的話\
\
看來今年開始🌸☄️兩人即將進入下一個階段了呢\
\
另外🌸也說到雖然沒那麼容易\
但自己還是很想辦2nd Live\
而且既然2026看來會是個不錯的一年\
自己也會很期待\
\
🌸 mentioned:\
Although ☄️would like to play Holonalds with everyone,\
because work has been so busy,\
she probably won’t be able to join them on January.\
\
🌸 also said 🌸☄️ went to a palmistry fortune-telling session 🔮\
together with Anemachi during ☄️’s rare day off.\
🔮 mentioned that this year will be a year of preparation and challenges for 🌸,\
and for both 🌸 and ☄️, 2026 will be a very good year.\
\
🌸 continued, saying\
last year 🌸☄️ also went to a🔮 with a big group of people.\
Back then, the🔮 also said that 2026\
would be a very important year for 🌸☄️.\
Hearing the same thing from two different🔮,\
it seems like 🌸☄️ will be entering a new stage starting this year.\
\
In addition, 🌸 mentioned that\
although it won’t be easy, she really wants to hold a 2nd Live.\
And since 2026 seems like it will be a good year,\
she’s really looking forward to it!\
🎹配信聊到\
🌸☄️原本在☄️本月難得的休假那天\
有約要吃起士鍋\
☄️當時有再約🎹過來一起吃\
但🎹覺得去當💡不好\
所以本來沒有要去的\
結果後來🌸閃到背去不了\
☄️就跟🎹說妳還是過來吃吧\
🎹又再找了🐧\
🐧因為工作關係晚點才能到\
🎹先到了☄️🏠\
看到☄️🏠姐妹的日常相處讓🎹覺的很新鮮\
\
而重點是\
之後姊街對於🌸不來了的反應是\
🌸是主催者怎麼能不來\
所以又把背痛的🌸硬是叫來了⋯\
\
🎹 talked during the stream about\
🌸☄️ originally planned to have cheese fondue on ☄️’s rare day off this month.\
☄️ even invited 🎹 to join them,\
but 🎹 felt it wouldn’t be right to go as a💡,\
so she initially decided not to go.\
\
However, 🌸 hurt her back and couldn’t make it.\
☄️ then told 🎹, “You should just come eat anyway.”\
🎹 ended up inviting 🐧 as well.\
Since 🐧 had work, she could only arrive later,\
so 🎹 arrived at ☄️’s house first.\
\
Seeing the everyday interactions between ☄️ and her sister at home felt really refreshing for 🎹.\
\
The highlight, though, was when Anemachi reacted to 🌸 not coming, saying,\
“🌸 is the organizer, how can she not show up?”\
In the end, Anemachi insisted on bringing injured 🌸 over…

但是真的從☄️那學到很多\
雖然兩人用的方法不同\
但到達那個大舞台的目標是一樣的\
\
🌸 said that after watching ☄️’s live, she felt even more motivated to hold a second one herself.\
\
Thinking back on the hardships she’s faced along the way,\
so many things have happened.\
In the past, she was often compared to others,\
constantly worrying about how to get people to come watch her.\
Not all memories are good ones,\
but it’s because of those experiences that 🌸 is who she is today.\
\
🌸thinks☄️ is truly incredible.\
Even though she admires ☄️,\
it’s not about becoming ☄️—\
it’s about becoming someone as active and successful as ☄️.\
\
What 🌸 wants to do is different from what ☄️ is doing.\
If she was to do the same thing, she would never be able to surpass ☄️.\
\
🌸 can’t stand on stage and sing as cool as ☄️.\
She needs to walk her own path and race in her own lane.\
\
🌸 can’t become ☄️,\
and ☄️ can’t become 🌸 either.\
But she has truly learned so much from ☄️.\
\
Even though they take different approaches,\
their goal of reaching that grand stage is the same.\
🌸從遠方看到了☄️\
便邊唱著BBDB邊跑向☄️\
（🌸見到☄️先打一下）\
\
☄️：🍌！\
\
🌸：是🍌☄️啊！🌸在這世上最喜歡的就是🍌☄️了⋯因為這個時候最乖了⋯對吧⋯彗醬？\
彗醬！Bluerose！（🌸丟花在☄️腳邊。）\
彗醬！⋯彗醬！過來幫忙！\
（☄️點頭。）\
\
此時不遠處傳來🍙的笑聲。\
\
🍙：上面好像有誰在？\
🌸：🍙！\
🍙：呀吼！☄️也在呀？\
🌸：Bluerose。\
\
（三人開始邊唱邊跳Bluerose。正確來說，因為☄️今天是無線電靜默模式所以只有🌸🍙兩人唱。)\
\
🍙：☄️live 辛苦了，真的超神的。\
🌸：真的很棒，Sui她哭了，哭慘了呢對吧。\
🍙：我有看到！，沒有放棄音樂真的太好了呢。\
\
（此時☄️開始彎著腰向後退。）\
\
🍙：啊在害羞了。\
🌸：害羞了啊。\
\
🌸 saw ☄️ from afar\
and ran towards ☄️ while singing BBDB.\
(🌸 gave ☄️ a little hit upon meeting.)\
\
☄️: 🍌!\
\
🌸: It’s 🍌☄️! The one I love most in this world is 🍌☄️…\
Because at times like this, you’re the most well-behaved… Right, Suichan?\
Suichan! Blue Rose!\
(🌸 threw a flower at ☄️’s feet.)\
Suichan! …Suichan! Come help!\
(☄️ nodded.)\
\
At that moment, laughter could be heard from a short distance away.\
\
🍙: Looks like someone’s up there?\
🌸: 🍙!\
🍙: Yahhoo! ☄️ is here too?\
🌸: Bluerose.\
\
(The three of them started singing and dancing to Bluerose.\
Technically, since ☄️ was in radio silence mode today, only 🌸 and 🍙 were singing.)\
\
🍙: ☄️, great job on the live! It was absolutely amazing.\
🌸: It really was. Sui cried—cried a lot, right?\
🍙: I saw! It’s really great that she never gave up on music.\
\
(At that moment, ☄️ started stepping back while bending over.)\
\
🍙: Ah, getting shy now.\
🌸: Getting shy, huh?\
🌸：看了☄️的武道館演唱會。真的太棒了。\
有發生好多事情，但是因為太感動了所以很多都忘了。\
☄️會哭那麼慘真的很少見呢。\
最後的那個留言想了很久\
但不知該怎麼寫\
不知怎麼用言語表達\
所以就寫了一句話\
(但是是最重要的一句）\
後來才發現自己寫的很少\
（這個我也是覺得如此⋯有時太親近的人反而會寫不出來）\
☄️說過想做的事都達成了\
\
🌸沒有去看別人的Live的習慣\
但是☄️會去\
之前☄️就有帶🌸去看別的Live\
然後看到別人有發彩帶的作法\
🌸便決定自己的Live也要用\
\
🌸: I watched ☄️’s Budokan concert. It was truly amazing.\
\
So many things happened, but I was so moved that I forgot a lot of them.\
\
It’s really rare to see ☄️ cry that much.\
\
I thought for a long time about what message to leave at the end,\
but I didn’t know how to put it into words,\
so I just wrote one sentence—\
(but the most important one).\
\
Later, I realized that I had written very little.\
(I feel the same way… Sometimes, when someone is too close to you, it’s even harder to find the right words.)\
\
☄️ said that everything she wanted to achieve has been accomplished.\
\
🌸 doesn’t have the habit of going to other people’s live concerts,\
but ☄️ does.\
\
Previously, ☄️ even took 🌸 to see another concert.\
\
Seeing how they gave out streamers,\
🌸 decided to use that idea for her own live\
 concert as well.

ctx:
這次廣播的來賓是Daoko，主持人內田敦子提到她是V的認真勢粉絲，每天都會觀看配信，也去了🌸的Sololive。Daoko也承認自己是宅女，還加入了☄️的會員，並提到曾經在廣播節目上與☄️共演過。Daoko也提到自己很喜歡☄️的新專輯，特別是《綺麗事》，得知這首歌是☄️自己作詞作曲後感到驚訝，並給予高度讚賞，讓☄️也對這首歌的評價感到安心。\
\
她談到自己是如何進入V文化的，最初是因為在YouTube上看到🏴‍☠️的MV《美少女無罪》，覺得世界觀很有趣，後來開始看V們的雜談配信，尤其被Holo的氛圍吸引，覺得像是女子高校般親切。\
\
當被問到最推的成員時，Daoko開玩笑表示要在☄️面前說這個可不容易。她說雖然自己是箱推，但最讓她心動的還是🌸。而且她也是☄️的⋯☄️接著說，是我的商業夥伴呢，內田在旁馬上喊  貼貼！\
\
Daoko說她過往從未追過偶像，卻因為🌸第一次產生了「想支持偶像」的心情。她特別欣賞🌸珍惜粉絲的努力，以及她在Live上各種細節的用心，認為作為偶像的🌸是一個值得依靠的存在。☄️也表示她也覺得🌸是一個很適合配信的V。\
\
她最喜歡的🌸的歌曲是《Flower Rhapsody》，這首歌的MV在Sololive後發布，內容讓她和眾多35P感動落淚，覺得自己真的是被自己的推愛著。☄️也認同表示這首MV為演唱會畫下完美句點。\
\
當被問到想對🌸說什麼時，Daoko興奮地表示自己真的很喜歡🌸，並表達會一直支持🌸，只要🌸活著就很感激了。內田說Daoko 真的是粉絲典範。\
\
The guest on this broadcast was Daoko. The host, Uchida Atsuko, mentioned that Daoko is a dedicated fan of Vtubers, watching streams every day and attending 🌸’s sololive. Daoko admitted that she is an otaku, has joined ☄️’s membership, and previously co-starred with ☄️ on a radio show. She also mentioned that she really likes ☄️’s new album, especially Kireigoto, and was surprised to learn that ☄️ wrote and composed the song herself. Her high praise reassured ☄️ about the song’s reception.\
\
Daoko talked about how she got into the Vtuber culture, saying that she first discovered it when she saw 🏴‍☠️’s music video Bishoujo Muzai on YouTube. She found the world-building fascinating and initially thought it was an animated project. Later, she started watching various Vtubers’ talk streams and was especially drawn to Hololive’s atmosphere, which she felt resembled an all-girls high school and made her feel at home.\
\
When asked who her favorite member was, Daoko jokingly said that answering in front of ☄️ made it difficult. She admitted that while she is a full-group supporter, the one who truly captured her heart is 🌸. ☄️ then chimed in, saying, “Ah, my business partner,” to which Uchida immediately reacted with, “TeTe!”\
\
Daoko shared that she had never followed idols before but, for the first time, felt the desire to “support an idol” because of 🌸. She particularly admires 🌸’s dedication to her fans and the care she puts into every detail of her live performances, believing that 🌸 is a truly reliable presence as an idol. ☄️ agreed, saying she also thinks 🌸 is a perfect fit for streaming.\
\
Her favorite song by 🌸 is Flower Rhapsody. The music video was released after 🌸’s sololive, and seeing the live performance scenes in the MV made her and many 35P cry. She felt deeply loved as a fan. ☄️ agreed, saying that the MV provided the perfect closure to the concert experience.\
\
When asked what she would like to say to 🌸, Daoko excitedly expressed that she really loves 🌸 and promised to always support her. She added that just knowing 🌸 is alive makes her feel grateful. Uchida then remarked that Daoko is truly a model fan.

ctx:
看著☄️蓋的🏘️，在決定要選哪一間的🌸。\
\
🌸：選哪個來當🌸家好呢？別莊。大家覺得哪個好呢？\
（看著左側那幢。）嗯⋯就這個吧！\
\
於是，🌸放了一塊牌子在那房子的大門上方，當作門牌，寫上：咪口的別莊。\
\
此時，☄️從這間房子裡走了出來，回頭看到🌸放的牌子，☄️立即砍了那個門牌。\
\
🌸：啊啊！！嗚⋯（櫻兒哭聲。）\
\
☄️砍完轉身進屋，🌸也跟著進去。\
\
🌸：Tsk⋯！這可是咪口的別⋯不可以嗎？\
\
☄️又走出屋子，🌸也跟著走出。☄️抬頭，示意要🌸往上面看。\
\
🌸抬頭一看，在大門的右上方更高處已經有一塊空白木牌。\
\
🌸：啊！是希望我寫在這裡的意思嗎？\
\
☄️看著🌸，然後點了點頭。\
\
🌸：（可愛音。）彗醬～！\
\
🌸看著☄️又轉身進屋子裡。\
\
🌸便在那木牌寫上：咪口別莊。\
\
🌸別莊！哇ㄚㄚ～～別莊！（很高興的進屋子裡去。）咪口的別莊！\
\
Looking at the houses ☄️ built, 🌸 was deciding which one to choose.\
\
🌸: Which one should I pick as my home? A villa… What does everyone think?\
(Looking at the one on the left.) Hmm… I’ll go with this one!\
\
So, 🌸 started writing a door plate: “Miko’s Villa.”\
\
At that moment, ☄️ walked out of that house, turned around, saw the door plate 🌸 had placed, and immediately destroyed it.\
\
🌸: Ahhh!! Ugh… (Sakura’s crying sound.)\
\
After destroying the sign, ☄️ turned around and went back inside. 🌸 followed after.\
\
🌸: Tsk…! This is Miko’s vil— Is that not allowed?\
\
☄️ walked out of the house again, and 🌸 followed. ☄️ then tilted their head upward, signaling 🌸 to look up.\
\
When 🌸 looked up, they saw a blank wooden sign already placed in the upper right corner of the entrance.\
\
🌸: Ah! Does this mean you want me to write it here?\
\
☄️ looked at 🌸 and nodded.\
\
🌸: (In a cute voice.) Sui-chan~!\
\
Watching ☄️ turn back and enter the house, 🌸 then wrote on the wooden sign: “Miko Villa.”\
\
🌸: A villa! Waaah~~ A villa! (Excitedly runs inside.) Miko’s Villa!

ctx:
☄️：彗醬在二月的配信時間多了很多對吧？對啊彗醬變成麥塊居民了。昨天說可能不會上來的，結果還是來麥塊了。為什麼能那麼常來？因為該做的事都做完了。去年底到今年初的巡迴演唱會還有武道館真的有夠辛苦的。今年我試著讓自己能有多一些自由的時間。好多工作我都回絕掉了。雖然很想參與每個找上門的工作，想說「請務必都讓我做！」但精神和肉體實在無法負荷了。所以今年真的要減少工作量。現在麥塊很療癒。今年會有春假了。\
\
💬：要來個商業旅行嗎？\
\
☄️：會想去旅行，真的想要放假。\
\
💬：彗醬去年也說過同樣的話。\
\
☄️：今年真的真的真的要休假了⋯年初時跟麻內講說「我不行了⋯不行了」而且其實從去年底開始就是這樣了⋯\
\
☄️: Suichan has been streaming a lot more in February, right? Yeah, I’ve basically become a Minecraft resident now. Yesterday, I said I might not log in, but I ended up playing Minecraft anyway.\
\
Why am I able to play so often? Because I’ve finished all the work I needed to do, and now I can finally relax. The tour from the end of last year to the beginning of this year, plus the Budokan concert, was incredibly tough.\
\
This year, I’m trying to give myself more free time. I’ve turned down a lot of work. Even though I really want to do everything, to take on every offer and say, “Please let me do it all!”—both my mind and body just can’t handle it anymore. So this year, I’m seriously cutting back on work and making time to relax. Minecraft is really therapeutic right now. And this year, I’ll finally have a spring break.\
\
💬: How about a business trip?\
\
☄️: I do want to travel—I really want to take a vacation.\
\
💬: You said the same thing last year.\
\
☄️: This year, I really, really, really have to take a break… At the start of the year, I told Mane-chan, “I can’t do this anymore… I just can’t.” Honestly, I’ve felt like this since the end of last year…
